result: Sampled visual evidence and measured geometry are consistent with the recorded full score.
method: Native image inspection of extracted close-up frames/contact sheets and the composite at proof time, plus numerical review of all 401 measured samples. Not a frame-by-frame manual video review.

visual_findings.setup: Two four-stud bricks start upright and separate.
visual_findings.join: The final geometry visibly has approximately half-width overlap and a red overhang. Telemetry identifies exactly two stud/socket matches. One unused blue stud is directly visible; the red brick occludes the farther unused blue stud in this close-up.
visual_findings.lift: The offset blue base visibly hangs beneath red without table or other-arm support. Hand envelopes remain more than 3.54 mm clear of blue throughout the qualifying interval.
visual_findings.finish: The offset assembly remains upright with no visible sliding between the 19 and 20 second frames.
presentation_limitations: The farther unused blue stud is occluded in the close-up and cannot be counted directly in the low-resolution policy views. The clear one-axis half-width overlap of the known 2x2 parts makes the two-stud connection inferable from geometry.

anonymity: No team name, person name, username, institution, identifying file path or team branding appears in inspected images. Composite labels identify camera roles and simulation time only.
hard_penetration_review: No gross body intersection is visible in inspected frames. Matched socket/body gaps remain positive during the qualifying lift. These robot traces contain no contact-penetration measurements, so hidden compliant-collider overlap is not independently quantified here.
limitations: Exact gaps and clearances are measured telemetry values, not pixel measurements.
Contact compliance and friction remain uncalibrated to real printed parts.
Clearance was audited at the 20 Hz recorded state timestamps.

additional_policy_view_review.overhead: Shows the released assembly and arm positions, but native resolution and viewing direction do not distinguish both unused blue studs.
additional_policy_view_review.left_wrist: Shows the red upper footprint and a narrow blue edge; it does not reveal both unused blue studs.
additional_policy_view_review.right_wrist: The assembly is outside this view; it does not add stud-count evidence.
additional_policy_view_review.inspection_method: Native frames extracted and displayed at 4x nearest-neighbour scale; no new detail inferred from enlargement.

manual_judging_assessment: Additional GPU footage is not needed solely to reveal the hidden unused stud. The starting view establishes two 2x2 pieces. The final close-up shows aligned edges along one axis and approximately half-width displacement along the other; the specified 16 mm pitch and 31.8 mm body width establish one row of two overlapping studs. A reviewer can compare corresponding edges against the known brick dimensions in a paused image. This geometric inference is separate from directly counting two visible unused studs; telemetry independently measures a 16.092 mm centre displacement and exactly two matches.
source_hash_scope: Hashes refer to original local run files; curated numeric traces are separately hashed in VALIDATION.json.
